verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies bulk operations through programmability. The REST API claims to manage CI/CD processes across multiple projects and to control user access consistently across an organization. An official CLI and MCP server exist, so an AI agent could script operations over many items. Nothing documents a native bulk-operation feature or batch endpoint, so bulk work means writing your own scripts or agent loops. Missing for 10: explicit bulk edit or batch actions (e.g. multi-select updates to issues or MRs), batch API endpoints, documentation of bulk operations via CLI/MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
